summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-named identifiers (obfuscator.io style) and, at npm install time, downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line string-array-rotation obfuscated bundle (WV8StW rotator, hc1jfK9 decoder, ~1500-entry constant table) whose behavior is not readable without deobfuscation. The package is advertised as a stylelint configuration and has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a large opaque executable payload at install time. The delivery pattern — obfuscated preinstall script fetching an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload — matches the alternate-runtime dropper shape and evades Node-based static scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
